sections.heading: 4. Application Health
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-131/health.png)

Application Health Dashboard Overview. Identity API HTTP 5xx fell from 61 to 34. Content API HTTP 5xx fell from 1.56k to 318 - [TinaCloud CloudWatch Dashboard](https://us-east-1.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=us-east-1#dashboards/dashboard/tinacloud-overview)

sections.heading: 5. TinaCloud PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-131/commits.png)

Total Commits processed by TinaCloud over the last 6 months, total commits (aka spits) over the last month was 39,129 (down 13% on the previous period) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-131/onboarding.png)

User onboarding over the last 7 days - 144 accounts were created, 26% (38) went on to create a project and 15% (22) committed. Of 107 invited collaborators, 57% (61) were added and 21% (22) committed - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-131/projects.png)

Organisation and project creation over the last 7 days - 147 new organisations, up from 129 last Sprint - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

sections.heading: 6. TinaCMS PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-131/dau.png)

Daily active users this month - peaking at 664 in mid-October, and at 633 in early November (dips are weekends) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)

![](/uploads/sprint-131/geo.png)

Distribution of unique TinaCMS users over the last 30 days - US is our top country with 1,582 users, down 162 on the prior 30 days, ahead of Germany on 650 and the UK on 549 - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)

sections.heading: 7. Cloners of Starter Templates
sections.note: Current Sprint counts are the sum of GitHub's daily unique cloners for Tue 3 Nov to Sun 9 Nov, so a person who cloned on two days counts twice.

sections.heading: 8. TinaCMS NPM Version Distribution
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-131/npm.png)

TinaCMS version downloads over the last week, the most popular version is v3.15.x with 17.7k total downloads (up 25% on last Sprint), ahead of v3.14.x on 12.5k and v3.12.x on 2.6k - [Tina Tracker](https://tina-dashboard-nine.vercel.app/downloads)
